description: StoryChief helps users search, inspect, create, and update workspace content from ChatGPT, including articles, social posts, webpages, newsletters, podcasts, video scripts, webinars, and ebooks. The app returns editor links, comment context, scheduling fields, and media details so users can continue review, approval, and publishing in StoryChief.
